idea: Simple ways to protect plumbing during renovation
title: Renovating Safely: Protect Your Pipes First
description: Planning a home remodel? Before demolition begins, take a few simple steps to safeguard your plumbing system. First, locate and test your main water shut-off valve so you can cut off supply quickly if needed. Next, cover open drain lines and exposed pipe ends with heavy-duty caps or tape to prevent drywall dust, tile grout, and construction debris from clogging your system. Always mark hidden pipe routes on walls before cutting or drilling. Finally, schedule a professional plumbing inspection while your walls are open to catch hidden leaks or aging pipes before new drywall goes up.
